en.headline: Thunderstorm Warning in force until 7:30 a.m.
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the warning at 5:20 a.m., expecting a few squally thunderstorms and intense gusts reaching 70 km/h or above over the territory.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued a Thunderstorm Warning at 5:20 a.m. on Wednesday, valid until 7:30 a.m. A few squally thunderstorms are expected to occur over Hong Kong.

The Observatory also warned that intense gusts reaching 70 kilometres per hour or above may affect the territory. Members of the public outdoors were advised to seek safe shelter as soon as possible, leave the water, avoid high ground and conductive objects, and take precautions against flying debris.

Drivers on highways and flyovers were urged to reduce speed. Special weather tips earlier in the morning had noted a band of thundery showers edging closer, with heavier rain and squally thunderstorms possible in the next couple of hours.

zh.headline: 雷暴警告生效至上午7時30分
zh.dek: 天文台於清晨5時20分發出雷暴警告，預料本港有幾陣狂風雷暴，並可能出現時速70公里或以上強陣風。
body: 香港天文台於星期三上午5時20分發出雷暴警告，有效時間至上午7時30分，預料香港有幾陣狂風雷暴。
天文台同時指出，預料高達每小時70公里或以上的強陣風吹襲香港。市民如身處室外應儘快到安全地方躲避，離開水面，切勿站立於高地或接近導電物體、樹木或桅杆，並提防飛散或墜落物件。
在高速公路或天橋上的駕車人士應減低車速。較早前的特別天氣提示亦指，一道雷雨帶正逐漸靠近，未來兩三小時本港部分地區雨勢較大及有狂風雷暴。
